description.plain:
Shift is a space-saving sleeper sofa that redefines small-space comfort. Designed to do more with less, it transforms from a modern sofa to a true queen-size bed in seconds - no clunky pullouts, no heavy lifting.

Built with a CertiPUR-US® all-foam mattress and PFAS-free, stain-resistant fabric, Shift is made for real sleep and real life. Even the arm cushions pull double duty as standard pillows, making every inch as functional as it is thoughtful.

Perfect for apartments, guest rooms, or flexible living spaces, Shift combines sleek design with effortless versatility—proving that comfort and simplicity can share the same footprint.

- Queen-sized mattress - Arm cushions convert to standard pillows - CertiPUR-US® certified - PFAS-free fabric

Span is a modern sleeper sofa designed for real life — where comfort, function, and style all matter. Built with a queen-sized CertiPUR-US® mattress, it offers the comfort of a true bed with the polish of a modern sofa. No bulky mechanisms or awkward pullouts here — just a streamlined design that looks right at home in your main living space.

With its reversible chaise, supportive cushions, and easy-to-use fold-out design, Span transitions seamlessly from everyday lounging to overnight hosting. So you can finally have a sleeper sofa that doesn’t compromise on comfort, design, or durability.

  • Reversible chaise
